title: Pan-Seared Salmon Kebabs
description: A light and indulgent Icelandic-inspired dish featuring pan-seared salmon kebabs. Serve with a side of norwegian-inspired vegetables.

ingredients.name: Vegetable skewers
ingredients.notes: including bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

ingredients.name: Norwegian herb mix
ingredients.notes: a blend of parsley, dill, and chives

instructions: Thread the salmon and vegetables onto the skewers.
In a small bowl, mix together the Norwegian herb mix and olive oil.
Brush the herb mixture onto the kebabs.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Heat a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the kebabs to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes.
Serve the kebabs hot with lemon wedges on the side.
